summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for an autologous stem cell transplant for IgA multiple myeloma. The transplant was performed successfully after placement of a central venous catheter. During the hospitalization, he developed mild diverticulitis on post-transplant day 3, which was treated with intravenous meropenem followed by oral ciprofloxacin and metronidazole, with clinical and radiographic improvement. He experienced transient lower extremity edema managed with IV furosemide, and his liver enzymes rose, attributed partly to prior alcohol use. His diabetes was managed with reduced insulin glargine and sliding scale lispro, and gabapentin was discontinued for neuropathy. He completed prophylactic antiviral and PJP prophylaxis, and was discharged home in stable condition with plans to start INH for latent tuberculosis and close outpatient follow-up.
